title: Filtering a bounded torsion locally constant module sheaf after a cover of degree prime to l
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma generalises the filtration statement from F_l-vector spaces to finite type locally constant Lambda-modules annihilated by l^n, over an irreducible geometrically unibranch scheme: after a finite etale cover of degree prime to l the pullback admits a finite filtration with successive quotients constant sheaves attached to finite Lambda-modules (statement lines 10478-10489). The proof translates the sheaf into a module with continuous fundamental group action (proof lines 10491-10505), realises the relevant finite quotient by a cover of the required degree (proof lines 10505-10518), and filters the pullback using the structure of modules over the group algebra of a finite group of order prime to l (proof lines 10518-10524). The non-formal content is the same as in the F_l case, now with the annihilator hypothesis supplying the bounded torsion. The claim is H2: one translation plus one filtration argument.
